column3: Saori Route ・ Kuroneko's Familiar
Summer vacation starts tomorrow, so everyone's leaving early.
Well, there isn't anyone who likes to stay on the day of the closing ceremony.
Oh. That's true.
Then, let's go home as well?
Ah, okay.
Hmm... That person over there is...
Kuroneko!
...oh, Kousaka-senpai, Tamura-senpai. Nice to meet you.
Good afternoon, Gokou-san.
You look like you're carrying many things, but are you all right? Shall I help?
Just as Manami says, Kuroneko was carrying bags in both hands.
I can see several books which are as thick as dictionaries stuffed inside.
It looks tough for Kuroneko to carry these.
There's no need for concern.
Only the Denizens of Darkness can handle these...
Denizens of Darkness?
I-It's nothing!
Just getting a little giddy from the heat, right, Kuroneko?
...It's useless talking to humans.
Ah-Ah-Ah!
Manami! I have something to discuss with Kuroneko, so could you go ahead first?
Okay. Got it, Kyou-chan.
...You.
Don't bring out your evil eye in front of Manami.
...Is that all? Then, I'll be leaving you behind.
Hey! There's no need to be in such a hurry.
Unfortunately, I am busy, unlike you.
I also have a meeting with Saori later on.
A meeting with Saori?
Yes. I absolutely need materials for my new publications to be released during Summer Comiket. This baggage is one part of said materials.
So I arranged a meeting with Saori to borrow some information booklets from her.
Summer Comiket's new publications?
Summer Comiket is that thingy, right? The otaku festival.
Putting that aside.
If I remember correctly, this Summer Comiket thing is held during the Lantern Festival period.
I'm not familiar with it, so I might be wrong.
Are you able to make it in time if you only start borrowing now?
...Hmph.
That's why I said that I'm busy.
Ah, I overlooked that!
But, now I kind of get what Kuroneko is trying to say.
Basically, something like "Let the Crunch Time begin!"
Even the usually calm and composed Kuroneko is on tenterhooks at the moment.
As such, she can't even spare time for chatting.
You know, regarding those information booklets...
How about I go get them for you?
Senpai will?
You're busy with the manuscript, right? I'm free anyway.
I also have something to ask Saori, you see.
If I get the booklets for you, you can work on the manuscript in the meantime.
...It's true that our interests align.
Yup.
Understood. Please help me with this transaction.
By all means, take care not to get addled by the summer heat.
I got Manami who was waiting for me to return home first, and then I went to the meeting place as directed by Kuroneko.
Although I know that...
It is summer. Mid-summer. Basically, the emancipation season.
Couples freed from societal etiquette going all over each other in public without reservations.
That couple sharing ice cream cones over there...
And this couple linking arms over here despite the crazy heat... Ohhohh, it's getting hot out here!
They're being so enviable... Damn!
Oh... is that Saori?
I found a girl who looked like Saori near the fountain.
Similar... Because her back is facing me.
Well, I can't believe that a tall girl like that would be all alone, so it probably is Saori.
Hey!
I tried calling out.
But, my voice got lost in the noise. It seemed like it didn't reach Saori.
Saori looked around the area restlessly, looking for Kuroneko.
Saoriii! Heyyy!
Kyou-Kyousuke-shi?!
Yo! It's been since the hospital!
Calling didn't work, mailing didn't work either.
Even Buddha's tranquil face only lasts until the third time.
It's impossible that a direct meeting will fail!
Even Buddha's tranquil face only lasts until the third time, Saori! You'll have to tell me what's troubling you today!
I said that as I tapped Saori's shoulder.
Kyousuke-shi...
I am very glad for this encounter, but...
Since I am bound to a meeting with Kuroneko-shi, as such... DORON!
Hey! Wait!
No one will wait when asked to!
Saori, displaying unbelievable sprinting skills, slipped through the commoners and headed toward the park's exit.
Her figure gradually became smaller and smaller...
Unable to do anything, I could only watch her back as she got away.
Running away as you see someone's face is a friend's disgrace!
I don't care about you anymore! Suit yourself!
I watched her get away and decided to return home.
For some reason.
I had a feeling that I wouldn't be able to meet Saori ever again if I let her escape now.
Saori, wait! Don't flee!
Aw!!
Ouch ouch ouch!!
Kyousuke-shi! It hurts!
Huh? A-Ah, sorry!
Really... Suddenly gripping my arm...
Isn't Kyousuke-shi's treatment toward ladies slightly violent?
I told you I'm sorry! But...
But if I lost sight of you here, I had a feeling I wouldn't be able to meet you again...
Kyousuke-shi...
So Kyousuke-shi finally caught the same sickness Kuroneko has...
NO!
I'm absolutely not one of those "Evil Eyes"!
Ha Ha Ha! Well, jokes aside...
In the hot month of August, Kirino, Kuroneko and Saori went there; meeting Ayase by chance and exposed Kirino's otaku side... That was a dreadful
time.
